_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Preservation, Packaging, and Packing (PP&P) Drawing(s)
summary: The Preservation, Packaging, and Packing (PP&P) Drawing(s) DID documents in descriptive detail Level A preservation, packaging, and packing employed by the contractor to protect Government equipment during handling, storage, and shipment.
use_relationship:
To document in descriptive detail Level 'A' preservation, packaging, and packing employed by the contractor in providing protection in the handling, storage, and shipment of Government equipment.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described by MIL-E-17555(2), Electronic and Electrical Equipment, Accessories, and Provisioned Items (Repair Parts), entire content, and NSA Data Standard 61, and Appendix A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Document.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as cited in the current issue of the DODISS at the time of the solicitation and for non-DODISS-listed documents as stated herein. NSA Data Standard 61, the current edition, and Appendix A can be found at Department of Defense, National Security Agency, 9800 Savage Rd, Fort George G. Meade, Md. 20755-6000; Attention: I5221.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: Shall be in the contractor's format.

children.title: When the Government has not provided
children.content: Government-Furnished (GF) PP&P drawings, representing Level A, Preservation, Packaging, and Packing in accordance with MIL-E-17555, Electronic and Electrical Equipment, Accessories, and Provisioned Items (Repair Parts): Packaging of, the contractor shall prepare the set of PP&P drawings in accordance with Data Standard 61 and Appendix A which truly depicts Level A PP&P requirements of the contract. The PP&P drawings shall reflex the detail, in both sketch and narrative, the sequence of all steps taken by the contractor in the packaging and packing of the equipment, ancillary equipment, and a typical equipment spare parts pack exhibit. The drawings shall also contain necessary information detailing unit packaging, methods, submethods, materials, shipping weight, and cubic foot displacement of the shipping container. All materials used in the packaging and packing sequences shall be related to applicable Federal or Military Specifications and their pertinent types, grades, styles, and classes. When Government specifications are not available, the materials shall be detailed and the vendor source indicated.

children.title: When GF PP&P drawings are provided
children.content: the contractor has the option of meeting the requirements of the contract by:

children.title: Modifying, when necessary, the GF PP&P drawings(s)
children.content: in accordance with the revision requirements of Data Standard 61 and Appendix A to satisfy all contract PP&P requirements, or

children.title: Preparing new PP&P drawing(s) in accordance
Regardless of the option exercised, the
children.content: contractor shall be responsible for meeting all contractual requirements for PP&P. The contractor shall furnish copies, as specified in the contract, or new or revised PP&P drawings(s) to the Government for review. Government approval of the PP&P drawings(s) is based upon the successful completion of the Rough Handling Tests and full compliance with the requirements of Data Standard 61 and Appendix A for drawing preparation.

children.title: Delivery of the drawings(s)
children.content: shall be in accordance with the DD Form 1423.
